lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with vertical spacing between centroids being narrower than horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the blob centroids, creating a grid-like framework where the blobs serve as primary vertices.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced horizontal linear boundary exhibiting a sharp luminance transition (lighter dorsal, darker ventral) running along the upper third of the visible flank.
